title: change-set document
description: One change set across planners (#3181): what a combined run's chant, terraform, tofu, choudoufu, warden and sql members will change, a summary, and the digest a gate binds. Written by the composeChangeSet Op activity and by composeChangeSet in @intentius/chant/change-set. Version 1 of the workspace read contract. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version.

chant.description: The chant that composed the document.

digest.description: computePlanDigest("change-set-document", …) over the set digest (computePlanDigest("change-set", …) over the members' { member, planDigest } pairs sorted by member), each member's member, status and holes, the entries without their node and source, the side effects, and on a release gate's document its releaseDigest and environment, provisional members and their entries left out. What a gate over the whole run binds.

releaseDigest.description: Added in contract 1 by #4045, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. The release a release gate's change set was planned for: the releaseDigest of the release chant components promote --release deploys. Set with environment, and absent on every other change set. Part of digest, so a stored change set names the one release its gate bound.

environment.description: Added in contract 1 by #4045, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer. The environment a release gate's change set was planned for, set with releaseDigest. Part of digest.

members.description: Sorted by member. Each name appears once.

entries.description: Sorted by member, address, deposed key and action.

sideEffects.description: Provider-defined actions an apply runs (Terraform actions blocks), sorted by member and address. Absent when none.

graph.description: Added in contract 1 by #4022, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer on a stored change set. The graph the entries' node ids come from: the workspace member whose graph it is (null outside a workspace) and the commit it was read at (null when unknown). Null when no graph could be read, so every node is null. Absent on a document never mapped. Not part of digest.

member.description: The workspace member, or the root a set plan names.

scope.description: The estate, environment or org the member plans into.

planDigest.description: What a gate on this member alone binds. null when it failed to plan.

nativeDigest.description: The planner's own digest of the same plan, such as choudoufu's per-root digest.

provisional.description: Planned before what it reads applied, so it may hold stand-in values (a Terragrunt dependent planned on mock_outputs). Left out of the document's digest, refused by a wave's set digest, and never grouped with real plans.

placeholders.description: The inputs the member was previewed with stand-in values for (#4463), as var.<name>, sorted. Every attribute they drive is marked unknown in its entries, and its planDigest covers them.

holes.description: What the planner could not read, so the plan says nothing about it.

group.description: Added in contract 1 by #4440, written by chant 0.124.53 and newer. Set on a member a capability planned with others as one group (ws-107). Part of digest when present.

digest.description: The group digest folded into planDigest: computePlanDigest("capability-group", ...) over the capability's kind, each member's component, member and own plan digest, and the capability's digest of the composition.

reads.description: The <component>.<output> values the member reads from another member of its group that the plan does not know, sorted. The group's apply computes them. A change set with any is never passed as empty.

address.description: The planner's address, unique within the member with deposed.

name.description: The resource name without module path or index.

id.description: The provider's id, when the planner reports one.

importing.description: The entry also imports the object into state; action is what else the plan does to it.

disruption.description: Set on update, replace and delete.

mayAppear.description: Added in contract 1 by #4453. The planner could not enumerate what the entry stands for: a Pulumi resource registered inside an apply() whose input is unknown at preview. One entry per component whose children may appear, at <component URN with $* after its type and /* after its name>, and one per resource the last stack export holds under such a component that the preview did not list or plans to delete. Never dropped; a change set with one is never empty. Part of digest.

node.description: Added in contract 1 by #4022, written by chant 0.124.28 and newer on a stored change set (chant change-set show). The graph node the entry changes, as chant graph --format ir names it, with the member in front (<member>/<id>) inside a workspace, as chant workspace graph names it. A chant entry's node is its address; a terraform-family entry's is <root>/<block key>, where the block key is each module call as module.<name>/ and then the block's address with no index. Since #4454 an instance of a count or for_each block gets the instance node's id, the block node's id followed by the instance key as the planner prints it (<root>/aws_eip.pool[0], <root>/aws_eip.pool["a"]), with instanceOf naming the block node; an instance under an expanded module call keeps the block node. Null when the graph holds no node for the address, such as a delete of a block the source no longer declares. Absent on a document never mapped onto a graph. Not part of digest.

instanceOf.description: Added in contract 1 by #4454. Set when node is an instance node of a count or for_each block: the id of the block node it is an instance of, in the same id space as node. The block node is the rollup. Absent on every other entry. Not part of digest.

source.description: Added in contract 1 by #4025, written by chant 0.124.29 and newer on a stored change set. The source file that declares the entry's node, as a path from the repository root: the node's sourceLoc.file in the member's graph IR with the member's directory in front. Absent when node is null or the node has no source location, and on a change set stored by an older chant. workspace status attributes the entry to a work item through the commits linked to the item that changed this file. Not part of digest.

unknown.description: The value is known only after apply.

sensitive.description: Marked sensitive: neither value is carried.
